title: Local equality of restricted strictly perfect complex maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $P$ a strictly perfect cochain complex on the slice over $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let $Z\subseteq V\subseteq U$ be opens and $x\in Z$. Let $a,b:(P|_V)|_Z\to(P|_V)|_Z$ be chain maps [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If their termwise open module stalk maps at $x$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor] are equal, there is $W\subseteq Z$ containing $x$ where the restricted chain maps agree.

proof.text: Extract the degree-n equality at the stalk. Apply the finite-retract module-map equality theorem to P.X n and the retraction supplied by strict perfection.

Induct on the finite set of degrees in a support interval. At insertion intersect the two neighbourhoods; equality persists under further restriction by the sectionwise comparison of iterated restriction with direct restriction and naturality.

For a degree outside the support interval its source is zero. Restriction preserves zero objects, so the two components agree without shrinking. Assemble all component equalities using HomologicalComplex.hom_ext.

theorem exists_perfect_open_stalk_chain_map_eq
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (x : X) (V Z : X.Opens) (hxZ : x ∈ Z) (hVU : V ≤ U) (hZV : Z ≤ V)
    (a b :
      (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hZV)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ⟶
      (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hZV)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (heq : ((openModuleStalkFunctor X Z ⟨x, hxZ⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a =
      ((openModuleStalkFunctor X Z ⟨x, hxZ⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map b) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWZ : W ≤ Z), x ∈ W ∧
      ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hWZ)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a =
      ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hWZ)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map b
